summary: {golfer} brings two adult prices to the hearing because a shorter round is the one they can usually fit in.
realLife: Portland's budget note identified both nine-hole and eighteen-hole adult rounds when it directed staff where to seek additional revenue.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
